name: Tonarizuma 2 ~Inwaku no Keibou~
source:
Takahiro works as a system engineer. One day, he accidentally finds a secret file at his client's house. The file contains data on the client's wife having sex with someone. From that day, his life dramatically changes... Rich and beautiful wives... Everyone has a secret aspect... His personality gradually breaks down...

[From Erogeshop]
